title: Farmer Behind The U.S.'s Largest Organic Food Fraud Scheme Dies By Suicide | TIME
summary: News report on the death of the farmer behind the largest US organic grain fraud, who sold conventional corn and soy as organic feed.

assertions.quote: his corn and soybeans were sold primarily as feed for chickens and cattle the meat from those animals was advertised as organic
his sales equaled up to seven percent of organic corn growth in the country in 2016
